input.quote: 12.4 For eighteen months after termination Customer will not solicit or engage any person employed by Vendor at any time during the term.
input.rationale: § 12.4 binds only the Customer, runs eighteen months from termination, covers any person employed by Vendor at any time during the term (not just personnel involved in the Services), bars "engaging" as well as soliciting (a no-hire), and has no general-advertising or unsolicited-approach carve-out. That fails the fallback on every material term and the no-hire/all-personnel scope is walk-away territory; it also conflicts with § 12.3, in which Vendor acknowledges Customer has made no no-hire commitment. Redline follows the redline guidance and precedent by narrowing to the fallback: mutual, limited to personnel directly involved in the Services, twelve months from the end of involvement, no-hire deleted and customary carve-outs added.

proposal.summary: Make § 12.4 mutual, limit to personnel directly involved in the Services for 12 months, delete the no-hire ("engage") element and add general-advertising/unsolicited-approach carve-outs.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We do not accept non-solicits binding the Customer, and this one is one-sided, runs eighteen months, reaches every Vendor employee and bars engagement as well as solicitation, which also conflicts with § 12.3. As a fallback we have made it mutual, limited it to personnel directly involved in the Services for twelve months, removed the no-hire element and added the customary general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs.

ops.oldText: For eighteen months after termination Customer will not solicit or engage any person employed by Vendor at any time during the term.
ops.newText: For twelve months after the end of a person's involvement in the Services, neither party will directly solicit for employment any personnel of the other party who were directly involved in the Services. This restriction does not apply to general advertisements or other recruitment not specifically targeted at such personnel, or to unsolicited approaches by such personnel, and neither party is restricted from hiring or engaging any person.
